ko.title: 74를 기록한 서비스업 지수: ISM "지불가격" 지수에 경제학자들이 주목하는 이유

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: 널리 팔로우되는 기업 설문조사에서 투입 비용이 3년여 만에 가장 빠른 속도로 상승하고 있는 것으로 나타나자 경제학자들이 주목하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: 미국 공급관리협회(ISM) 서비스업 "지불가격(prices paid)" 지수의 최신 치는 2022년 중반 이후 가장 높은 수준인 74를 기록했습니다.

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: 이는 많은 서비스 제공업체들에게 비용 압박이 아직 완전히 사라지지 않았음을 일깨워 줍니다.

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 이 수치가 무엇을 의미하는지, 이것이 어떻게 일상적인 가계 예산에 영향을 미칠 수 있는지, 그리고 왜 연방준비제도(Fed)가 직면한 과제를 가중하시키는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 본 기사는 해설을 위한 것이며 재정적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## ISM "지불가격" 지수가 측정하는 것

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: ISM은 매달 서비스 부문의 구매 및 공급 담당 임원들을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시합니다.

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: 질문 중 하나는 자재, 물품 및 서비스에 대해 지불하는 가격이 전월 대비 상승했는지, 하락했는지, 아니면 변동이 없는지 묻습니다.

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **50을 초과하는 치**는 가격 하락보다 가격 상승을 보고한 응답자가 더 많음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **50 미만의 치**는 그 반대를 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **50보다 높을수록 비용 상승 보고가 더 광범위하다는 것을 의미합니다.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: 따라서 74라는 치는 설문조사에 참여한 기업의 대다수가 구매하는 항목에 대해 더 많은 비용을 지불하고 있음을 시그널로 보냅니다.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: 확산지수(diffusion index)이기 때문에 퍼센트 기준의 상승 폭이 아니라 가격 상승이 얼마나 *광범위한지*를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: 높은 치는 많은 기업이 더 높은 비용을 겪고 있음을 의미하지만 정확히 얼마만큼인지 알려주지는 않습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## 서비스 부문이 그토록 중요한 이유

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: 서비스업은 미국 경제의 대부분을 차지하며

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: 가계 지출의 큰 비중을 차지합니다.

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: 여기에는 외식, 의료, 보험, 교통, 숙박, 주택 수리, 개인 관리 및 전문 서비스가 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: 서비스 인플레이션은 상품 인플레이션보다 더 지속되는(sticky) 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: 서비스 비용의 큰 부분은 임금이며, 임금은 한 번 오르면 빠르게 다시 떨어지지 않는 것이 일반적입니다.

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: 임대료, 보험료, 계약 가격 조정도 느리게 진행됩니다.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: 결과적으로 서비스 부문에서 비용 압박이 쌓이면 시스템에서 이것이 해소되기까지 오랜 시간이 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## 기업 비용에서 소비자 물가로

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 종종 가격 압박의 "파이프라인"을 설명합니다.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: 한 단계에서 비용이 상승하면 기업은 그 인상분 중 얼마를 자체 흡수하고 얼마를 전가할지 결정합니다.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: 높은 지불가격 치가 사람들이 지불하는 가격으로 연결되는 몇 가지 경로가 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **식당 식사.** 식재료, 포장재, 에너지, 주방 및 서빙 인력 임금이 모두 메뉴 가격에 반영됩니다. 이 중 여러 요소가 함께 오르면 업주는 가격을 올리거나 양을 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **수리 및 유지보수.** 부품, 공구, 서비스 차량용 연료, 숙련 노동력이 모두 자동차 수리, 가전 서비스, 주택 프로젝트 청구액에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **보험 및 전문 서비스.** 청구 비용과 운영 경비 상승은 갱신 시 보험료나 수수료 인상으로 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **여행 및 숙박.** 연료, 청소, 인력 배치 및 유지보수 비용은 운임과 숙박 요금에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: 비용 전가가 즉각적이거나 완전하게 이루어지는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: 경쟁 상황, 소비자의 저항, 각 기업의 이윤율 등이 비용 인상분 중 얼마가 최종 가격에 도달할지에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: 일부 기업은 당분간 상승한 비용을 흡수하는 반면, 다른 기업은 빠르게 조정합니다.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: 그렇기 때문에 설문조사 치는 정밀한 예측이라기보다는 조기 시그널로 보는 것이 가장 적절합니다.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## 연준의 업무를 복잡하게 만드는 이유

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 연방준비제도는 물가 안정과 완전 고용을 목표로 합니다.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 많은 인플레이션 지표를 주시하며, 서비스 가격은 지속성이 높고 노동 시장과 밀접하게 연결되어 있어 특별한 주의를 기울입니다.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: 높은 지불가격 치는 몇 가지 어려움을 만듭니다:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **인플레이션 둔화 진전을 지연시킬 수 있습니다.** 기업이 비용 상승에 직면하면 계속해서 가격을 올릴 수 있으며, 이는 인플레이션을 연준의 2% 목표로 되돌리는 것을 더 어렵게 만듭니다.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **정책 완화의 여지를 줄입니다.** 금리 인하는 성장과 고용을 뒷받침할 수 있지만, 수요와 물가를 높은 수준으로 유지시킬 수도 있습니다. 과열된 비용 시그널은 당국자들로 하여금 금리 인하에 대해 더 신중해지도록 만듭니다.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **혼재된 시그널을 보냅니다.** 비용이 상승하는 동시에 성장이나 고용이 둔화되고 있다면, 정책 입안자들은 일자리 지원과 물가 억제 사이에서 트레이드오프에 직면하게 됩니다.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 설문조사만으로 정책이 결정되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: 연준은 고용 지표, 임금 상승률, 인플레이션 기대를 비롯하여 소비자물가지수(CPI) 및 개인소비지출(PCE) 물가지수와 같은 공식 인플레이션 데이터를 살핍니다.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 ISM 데이터는 적시성이 높고 많은 정부 보고서보다 먼저 발표되므로, 해당 보고서들이 무엇을 보여줄지에 대한 기대를 형성할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## 염두에 두어야 할 유의 사항

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **설문조사는 하드 데이터가 아닙니다.** ISM 지수는 구매 담당자의 의견을 반영하며, 월별 수치는 변동성이 클 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **한 달의 수치가 트렌드는 아닙니다.** 경제학자들은 일반적으로 수개월 동안 지수가 높은 수준을 유지하는지 확인하고자 합니다.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **비용 압박이 곧 소비자 인플레이션과 같지는 않습니다.** 일부 기업은 인상분을 흡수할 수 있으며, 공식 물가지수는 설문조사 결과와 다르게 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **다른 요인들이 지수를 왜곡할 수 있습니다.** 에너지 가격, 무역 정책, 기상 현상 또는 공급망 차질은 장기적인 양상을 바꾸지 않으면서 일시적으로 비용을 올릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 주시해야 할 것

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: 분석가들은 다음 몇 가지 항목에서 확인을 거치고자 할 것입니다:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - 다음 ISM 서비스업 보고서: 지불가격이 높은 수준을 유지하는지 아니면 완화되는지 여부.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - 공식 CPI 및 PCE 인플레이션 데이터: 특히 서비스 카테고리.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - 임금 상승률 및 노동 시장 보고서.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - 연준 당국자들이 최근 데이터를 어떻게 평가하고 있는지에 대한 발언.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: 74라는 지불가격 치가 소비자 물가의 급등을 보장하는 것은 아니지만, 서비스 경제의 비용 압박이 여전히 활발함을 시사합니다.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: 가계의 입장에서는 일상적인 서비스 가격의 지속적인 상승을 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: 연준의 입장에서는 안정적인 인플레이션으로 돌아가는 길이 순탄하지 않을 수 있음을 보여주는 또 하나의 증거입니다.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 헤드라인 수치에 의존하기보다는 시간에 따라 여러 데이터 출처를 관찰하는 것이 가장 명확한 그림을 제공합니다.

segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 재정, 투자 또는 경제적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.*

zh.title: 服务业价格指标达74：为何ISM“支付价格”数据引发经济学家密切关注

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: 当一项备受关注的商业调查显示投入成本以三年多来的最快速度上升时，经济学家们便会密切关注。

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: 美国供应管理协会（ISM）服务业“支付价格”指数的最新数据达到了74，创下2022年中期以来的最高水平。

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: 这提醒人们，许多服务提供商面临的成本压力尚未完全消退。

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: 本文将解释这一数字意味着什么，它如何传导至日常家庭预算，以及为什么它增加了美联储面临的挑战。

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 本文仅供解读说明，不构成财务建议。

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## ISM“支付价格”指数衡量的是什么

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: ISM每月都会对服务业的采购与供应高管进行调查。

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: 其中一个问题询问他们为原材料、供应品和服务支付的价格与上月相比是更高、更低还是持平。

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **读数高于50** 意味着报告价格上涨的受访者多于报告价格下跌的受访者。

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **读数低于50** 则意味着相反的情况。

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **读数越高于50，表明报告成本上升的范围越广。**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: 因此，74的读数表明，绝大多数被调查的企业都在为其采购的东西支付更高的价格。

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: 因为这是一个扩散指数，它反映的是价格上涨的*广泛性*，而不是按百分比计算的涨幅大小。

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: 高读数意味着许多企业正面临更高的成本，但它并没有明确指出具体上涨了多少。

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## 为什么服务业如此重要

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: 服务业构成了美国经济的大部分，

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: 也是家庭开支的重要组成部分。

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: 这包括外出就餐、医疗保健、保险、交通、住宿、房屋维修、个人护理和专业服务。

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: 服务业通胀往往比商品通胀更具黏性。

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: 服务成本很大一部分是劳动力成本，而工资一旦上涨，通常不会迅速回落。

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: 房租、保险费和合同定价的调整也很缓慢。

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: 因此，当服务业的成本压力累积时，可能需要很长时间才能在系统中得到化解。

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## 从企业成本到消费者价格

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: 经济学家经常将价格压力描述为一个“管道”。

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: 在一个阶段成本上升，企业决定吸收多少涨幅以及向外转嫁多少。

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: 有几个渠道可以将高支付价格读数与人们支付的费用联系起来：

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **餐馆用餐。** 食品原料、包装、能源以及厨房和后厨侍应生工资都会影响菜单价格。当其中几项同时上涨时，店主可能会提高价格或缩减分量。

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **维修与保养。** 零部件、工具、服务车辆燃料和熟练劳动力都会影响汽车维修、家电服务和房屋项目的账单。

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **保险与专业服务。** 更高昂的理赔成本和运营费用可能会在续约时表现为保费或服务费的增加。

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **旅游与住宿。** 燃料、清洁、人员配备和维护成本都会影响票价和房价。

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: 价格转嫁很少是立即或完全的。

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: 竞争、客户抵触情绪以及每家企业的利润率都会影响成本增加传导至最终价格的程度。

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: 一些企业会吸收一段时间的成本上升，而另一些企业则会迅速调整。

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么调查读数最好被视为早期信号，而不是精确预测的原因。

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## 为什么它使美联储的工作复杂化

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 美联储的目标是物价稳定和充分就业。

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: 政策制定者密切关注许多通胀指标，而服务价格受到了特别关注，因为它们具有持续性且与劳动力市场紧密相关。

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: 高支付价格读数带来了一些困难：

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **它可能会放缓通胀改善的进程。** 如果企业面临成本上升，它们可能会继续提高价格，这使得将通胀率拉回美联储 2% 的目标变得更加困难。

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **它收窄了宽松政策的空间。** 降低利率可以支持增长和招聘，但也可能维持高企的需求和价格。过热的成本信号使官员们在降息方面更加谨慎。

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **它释放了矛盾的信号。** 如果增长或招聘在成本上升的同时降温，政策制定者将面临在支持就业和遏制物价之间的权衡。

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: 没有单一的调查能决定政策。

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: 美联储会参考官方通胀数据，如消费者价格指数（CPI）和个人消费支出（PCE）价格指数，以及就业数据、工资增长和通胀预期。

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，ISM数据非常及时，并且在许多政府报告之前发布，因此它们可以塑造人们对这些报告将展示什么内容的预期。

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## 需要牢记的注意事项

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **调查并非硬性数据。** ISM指数反映的是采购经理的观点，每月读数可能会有所波动。

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **单月数据不代表趋势。** 经济学家通常希望观察该读数是否会在几个月内保持在高位。

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **成本压力不等于消费者通胀。** 一些企业可能会吸收涨幅，且官方价格指数的走势可能与调查结果不同。

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **其他因素可能会扭曲读数。** 能源价格、贸易政策、天气事件或供应中断可能会在不改变长期趋势的情况下暂时推高成本。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来要注意什么

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: 分析师将在几个方面寻找确认信号：

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - 下一份ISM服务业报告，看看支付价格是保持高位还是有所缓解。

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - 官方CPI和PCE通胀数据，特别是服务业类别。

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - 工资增长和劳动力市场报告。

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - 美联储官员关于他们如何权衡近期数据的评论。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: 总结

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: 74的支付价格读数并不保证消费者价格一定会暴涨，但它表明服务业经济中的成本压力依然活跃。

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: 对于家庭来说，这可能意味着日常服务价格将继续上涨。

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: 对于美联储来说，这是又一个证据，表明重返通胀稳定之路可能不会一帆风顺。

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: 随着时间推移关注多个数据源，而不是依赖单一的头条新闻数字，才能获得最清晰的全貌。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成财务、投资或经济建议。*

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: इंस्टीट्यूट फॉर सप्लाई मैनेजमेंट (ISM) सर्विसेज "प्राइसेस पेड" इंडेक्स की नवीनतम रीडिंग 74 पर आई, जो मध्य 2022 के बाद से इसका सबसे उच्च स्तर है।

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## ISM "मूल्य भुगतान" सूचकांक क्या मापता है

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: ISM हर महीने सेवा क्षेत्र में क्रय और आपूर्ति अधिकारियों का सर्वेक्षण करता है।

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: एक प्रश्न पूछता है कि सामग्री, आपूर्ति और सेवाओं के लिए उनके द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली कीमतें पिछले महीने की तुलना में अधिक, कम या अपरिवर्तित हैं या नहीं।

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **50 से ऊपर की रीडिंग** का मतलब है कि अधिक उत्तरदाता गिरती कीमतों की तुलना में बढ़ती कीमतों की रिपोर्ट करते हैं।

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **50 से नीचे की रीडिंग** का अर्थ इसके विपरीत है।

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **50 से जितना ऊपर, बढ़ती लागत की रिपोर्ट उतनी ही व्यापक हैं।**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: इसलिए 74 की रीडिंग संकेत देती है कि surveyed फर्मों का एक बड़ा बहुमत जो वे खरीदते हैं उसके लिए अधिक भुगतान कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: क्योंकि यह एक प्रसार सूचकांक है, यह दिखाता है कि मूल्य वृद्धि कितनी *व्यापक* है, न कि प्रतिशत के संदर्भ में कितनी बड़ी है।

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: एक उच्च रीडिंग का मतलब है कि कई फर्मों को उच्च लागत दिखाई दे रही है, लेकिन यह यह नहीं बताता है कि बिल्कुल कितना।

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## सेवा क्षेत्र इतना महत्वपूर्ण क्यों है

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: सेवाएँ यू.एस. का अधिकांश हिस्सा बनाती हैं।

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: अर्थव्यवस्था और परिवारों द्वारा खर्च किए जाने वाले का एक बड़ा हिस्सा।

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: इसमें बाहर खाना, स्वास्थ्य सेवा, बीमा, परिवहन, आवास, घर की मरम्मत, व्यक्तिगत देखभाल और पेशेवर सेवाएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: सेवाओं की मुद्रास्फीति सामान की मुद्रास्फीति की तुलना में अधिक चिपचिपी होती है।

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: किसी सेवा की लागत का एक बड़ा हिस्सा श्रम है, और एक बार बढ़ने के बाद मजदूरी आमतौर पर जल्दी से वापस नहीं गिरती है।

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: किराया, बीमा प्रीमियम और अनुबंध मूल्य निर्धारण भी धीरे-धीरे समायोजित होते हैं।

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: परिणामस्वरूप, जब सेवाओं में लागत का दबाव बनता है, तो सिस्टम से बाहर निकलने में काफी समय लग सकता है।

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## व्यावसायिक लागत से उपभोक्ता कीमतों तक

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री अक्सर मूल्य दबाव की "पाइपलाइन" का वर्णन करते हैं।

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: लागत एक चरण में बढ़ती है, और व्यवसाय तय करते हैं कि उस वृद्धि का कितना हिस्सा अवशोषित करना है और कितना आगे बढ़ाना है।

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: कई चैनल उच्च मूल्य-भुगतान रीडिंग को लोगों द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली चीज़ों से जोड़ सकते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **रेस्तरां भोजन।** खाद्य सामग्री, पैकेजिंग, ऊर्जा, और रसोई और प्रतीक्षा कर्मचारियों का वेतन सभी मेनू कीमतों में फ़ीड करते हैं। जब इनमें से कई एक साथ बढ़ते हैं, तो मालिक कीमतें बढ़ा सकते हैं या हिस्से को छोटा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **मरम्मत और रखरखाव।** पार्ट्स, टूल्स, सर्विस व्हीकल्स के लिए ईंधन, और कुशल श्रम सभी कार की मरम्मत, उपकरण सेवा और घर की परियोजनाओं के बिल को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **बीमा और पेशेवर सेवाएं।** उच्च दावे की लागत और परिचालन खर्च नवीनीकरण के समय बढ़े हुए प्रीमियम या शुल्क के रूप में दिखाई दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **यात्रा और आवास।** ईंधन, सफाई, स्टाफिंग और रखरखाव की लागत किराए और कमरे की दरों को प्रभावित कर सकती है।

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: पास-थ्रू शायद ही कभी तत्काल या पूर्ण होता है।

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: प्रतिस्पर्धा, ग्राहक प्रतिरोध, और प्रत्येक फर्म का लाभ मार्जिन सभी इस बात को प्रभावित करते हैं कि लागत वृद्धि का कितना हिस्सा अंतिम मूल्य तक पहुँचता है।

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: कुछ व्यवसाय कुछ समय के लिए उच्च लागत को अवशोषित करते हैं, जबकि अन्य जल्दी से समायोजित करते हैं।

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि एक सटीक पूर्वानुमान के बजाय एक प्रारंभिक संकेत के रूप में सर्वेक्षण रीडिंग को सबसे अच्छा देखा जाता है।

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## यह फेड के काम को जटिल क्यों बनाता है

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: फेडरल रिजर्व का लक्ष्य स्थिर कीमतें और अधिकतम रोजगार है।

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माता कई मुद्रास्फीति संकेतकों को देखते हैं, और सेवा की कीमतों को विशेष ध्यान मिलता है क्योंकि वे लगातार हैं और श्रम बाजार से निकटता से जुड़े हुए हैं।

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: उच्च मूल्य-भुगतान रीडिंग कुछ कठिनाइयां पैदा करती है:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **यह मुद्रास्फीति पर प्रगति को धीमा कर सकता है।** यदि व्यवसायों को बढ़ती लागत का सामना करना पड़ता है, तो वे कीमतें बढ़ाना जारी रख सकते हैं, जिससे मुद्रास्फीति को फेड के 2% लक्ष्य पर वापस लाना कठिन हो जाता है।

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **यह नीति को आसान बनाने के लिए गुंजाइश को संकीर्ण करता है।** कम ब्याज दरें विकास और काम पर रखने का समर्थन कर सकती हैं, लेकिन वे मांग और कीमतों को भी ऊंचा रख सकती हैं। एक गर्म लागत संकेत अधिकारियों को दरों में कटौती के बारे में अधिक सतर्क करता है।

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **यह मिश्रित संकेत भेजता है।** यदि लागत बढ़ने के साथ-साथ विकास या काम पर रखना ठंडा हो रहा है, तो नीति निर्माताओं को नौकरियों का समर्थन करने और कीमतों को नियंत्रित करने के बीच एक व्यापार-बंद का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: कोई भी एकल सर्वेक्षण नीति को संचालित नहीं करता है।

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: फेड आधिकारिक मुद्रास्फीति डेटा को देखता है जैसे कि उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक और व्यक्तिगत उपभोग व्यय मूल्य सूचकांक, रोजगार के आंकड़ों, मजदूरी वृद्धि और मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदों के साथ।

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: फिर भी, ISM डेटा समय पर हैं और कई सरकारी रिपोर्टों से पहले प्रकाशित होते हैं, इसलिए वे इस बात की उम्मीदों को आकार दे सकते हैं कि वे रिपोर्ट क्या दिखाएंगी।

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## ध्यान में रखने योग्य चेتاवनियाँ

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **सर्वेक्षण कठिन डेटा नहीं हैं।** ISM सूचकांक क्रय प्रबंधकों की राय को दर्शाता है, और मासिक रीडिंग अस्थिर हो सकती है।

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **एक महीना कोई रुझान नहीं है।** अर्थशास्त्री आम तौर पर यह देखना चाहते हैं कि क्या रीडिंग कई महीनों तक ऊंची रहती है।

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **लागत का दबाव उपभोक्ता मुद्रास्फीति के समान नहीं है।** कुछ फर्म वृद्धि को अवशोषित कर सकती हैं, और आधिकारिक मूल्य सूचकांक सर्वेक्षण परिणामों से अलग तरह से आगे बढ़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **अन्य कारक रीडिंग को विकृत कर सकते हैं।** ऊर्जा की कीमतें, व्यापार नीति, मौसम की घटनाएं, या आपूर्ति व्यवधान दीर्घकालिक तस्वीर को बदले बिना अस्थायी रूप से लागत बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: विश्लेषक कई स्थानों पर पुष्टि की तलाश करेंगे:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - अगली ISM सेवा रिपोर्ट, यह देखने के लिए कि भुगतान की गई कीमतें उच्च रहती हैं या कम होती हैं।

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - आधिकारिक CPI और PCE मुद्रास्फीति डेटा, विशेष रूप से सेवा श्रेणियां।

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - मजदूरी वृद्धि और श्रम बाजार की रिपोर्ट।

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - फेड अधिकारियों की टिप्पणी कि वे हाल के डेटा का वजन कैसे कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: 74 की मूल्य-भुगतान रीडिंग इस बात की गारंटी नहीं देती है कि उपभोक्ता कीमतें बढ़ेंगी, लेकिन यह सुझाव देती है कि सेवा अर्थव्यवस्था में लागत का दबाव अभी भी सक्रिय है।

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: पारिवारिक परिवारों के लिए, इसका मतलब दैनिक सेवाओं के लिए निरंतर मूल्य वृद्धि हो सकता है।

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: फेड के लिए, यह एक और प्रमाण है कि स्थिर मुद्रास्फीति का रास्ता सुचारू नहीं हो सकता है।

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: समय के साथ कई डेटा स्रोतों का पालन करना, एक हेडलाइन नंबर पर भरोसा करने के बजाय, सबसे स्पष्ट तस्वीर देता है।

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and does not constitute financial, investment, or economic advice.*
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के लिए है और इसमें वित्तीय, निवेश या आर्थिक सलाह शामिल नहीं है।*

es.title: Un indicador de precios de servicios en 74: por qué la lectura de "precios pagados" del ISM hace que los economistas presten mucha atención

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: Cuando una encuesta empresarial seguida de cerca muestra que los costos de insumos aumentan al ritmo más rápido en más de tres años, los economistas prestan atención.

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: La última lectura del índice de "precios pagados" de servicios del Institute for Supply Management (ISM) se situó en 74, su nivel más alto desde mediados de 2022.

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: Es un recordatorio de que las presiones de costos no se han desvanecido por completo para muchos proveedores de servicios.

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica qué significa el número, cómo puede llegar a los presupuestos de los hogares cotidianos y por qué se suma al desafío que enfrenta la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Es un artículo explicativo, no asesoramiento financiero.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## Qué mide el índice de "precios pagados" del ISM

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: El ISM encuestó a ejecutivos de compras y suministro en todo el sector de servicios cada mes.

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: Una pregunta indaga si los precios que pagan por materiales, suministros y servicios son más altos, más bajos o sin cambios en comparación con el mes anterior.

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **Una lectura por encima de 50** significa que más encuestados informan precios al alza que a la baja.

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **Una lectura por debajo de 50** significa lo contrario.

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **Cuanto más por encima de 50, más extendidos están los informes de costos al alza.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, una lectura de 74 señala que una gran mayoría de las empresas encuestadas están pagando más por lo que compran.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: Debido a que es un índice de difusión, muestra qué tan *amplios* son los aumentos de precios, no qué tan grandes son en términos porcentuales.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: Una lectura alta significa que muchas empresas ven costos más altos, pero no dice exactamente cuánto.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Por qué el sector de servicios importa tanto

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: Los servicios representan la mayor parte de la economía de EE. UU.

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: y una gran parte de lo que gastan los hogares.

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: Eso incluye salir a cenar, atención médica, seguros, transporte, alojamiento, reparación del hogar, cuidado personal y servicios profesionales.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: La inflación de servicios tiende a ser más persistente que la inflación de bienes.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: Una gran parte del costo de un servicio es la mano de obra, y los salarios generalmente no bajan rápidamente una vez que han aumentado.

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: El alquiler, las primas de seguros y los precios de los contratos también se ajustan lentamente.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: Como resultado, cuando la presión de costos se acumula en los servicios, puede tomar mucho tiempo salir del sistema.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## De los costos empresariales a los precios al consumidor

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: Los economistas suelen describir una "tubería" de presión de precios.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: Los costos aumentan en una etapa y las empresas deciden cuánto de ese aumento absorber y cuánto trasladar.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: Varios canales pueden vincular una lectura alta de precios pagados con lo que paga la gente:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **Comidas en restaurantes.** Los ingredientes de alimentos, empaques, energía y los salarios del personal de cocina y meseros alimentan los precios del menú. Cuando varios de estos suben juntos, los propietarios pueden subir los precios o reducir las porciones.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **Reparaciones y mantenimiento.** Piezas, herramientas, combustible para vehículos de servicio y mano de obra calificada afectan la factura de reparaciones de automóviles, servicio de electrodomésticos y proyectos del hogar.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **Seguros y servicios profesionales.** Mayores costos de reclamos y gastos operativos pueden aparecer como primas o tarifas incrementadas en el momento de la renovación.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **Viajes y alojamiento.** Los costos de combustible, limpieza, personal y mantenimiento pueden influir en las tarifas y tasas de habitaciones.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: El traslado rara vez es inmediato o completo.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: La competencia, la resistencia de los clientes y el margen de beneficio de cada empresa afectan cuánto de un aumento de costos llega al precio final.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: Algunas empresas absorben costos más altos por un tiempo, mientras que otras se ajustan rápidamente.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: Es por eso que una lectura de encuesta se ve mejor como una señal temprana en lugar de un pronóstico preciso.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## Por qué complica el trabajo de la Fed

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: La Reserva Federal apunta a precios estables y empleo máximo.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: Los responsables de políticas observan muchos indicadores de inflación, y los precios de los servicios reciben especial atención porque son persistentes y están estrechamente vinculados al mercado laboral.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: Una lectura alta de precios pagados crea algunas dificultades:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **Puede ralentizar el progreso en la inflación.** Si las empresas enfrentan costos en aumento, pueden seguir subiendo los precios, lo que dificulta llevar la inflación de vuelta a la meta del 2% de la Fed.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **Estrecha el margen para flexibilizar la política.** Tasas de interés más bajas pueden apoyar el crecimiento y la contratación, pero también pueden mantener elevados la demanda y los precios. Una señal de costo caliente hace que los funcionarios sean más cautelosos sobre recortar tasas.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **Envía señales mixtas.** Si el crecimiento o la contratación se están enfriando al mismo tiempo que los costos aumentan, los responsables de políticas enfrentan una compensación entre apoyar empleos y contener precios.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: Ninguna encuesta única impulsa la política.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: La Fed observa datos de inflación oficiales como el Índice de Precios al Consumidor y el índice de precios de Gastos de Consumo Personal, junto con cifras de empleo, crecimiento salarial y expectativas de inflación.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: Aun así, los datos del ISM son oportunos y se publican antes que muchos informes gubernamentales, por lo que pueden moldear las expectativas sobre lo que mostrarán esos informes.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## Advertencias que vale la pena tener en cuenta

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **Las encuestas no son datos duros.** El índice ISM refleja las opiniones de los gerentes de compras, y las lecturas mensuales pueden ser volátiles.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **Un mes no es una tendencia.** Los economistas generalmente quieren ver si la lectura se mantiene elevada durante varios meses.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **La presión de costos no es lo mismo que la inflación al consumidor.** Algunas empresas pueden absorber aumentos, y los índices de precios oficiales pueden moverse de manera diferente a los resultados de la encuesta.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **Otros factores pueden distorsionar las lecturas.** Los precios de la energía, la política comercial, eventos climáticos o interrupciones en el suministro pueden elevar temporalmente los costos sin cambiar el panorama a largo plazo.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: Los analistas buscarán confirmación en varios lugares:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - El próximo informe de servicios del ISM, para ver si los precios pagados se mantendrán altos o se moderarán.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - Datos oficiales de inflación de IPC y PCE, particularmente las categorías de servicios.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - Informes de crecimiento salarial y del mercado laboral.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - Comentarios de los funcionarios de la Fed sobre cómo están sopesando los datos recientes.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: Una lectura de precios pagados de 74 no garantiza que los precios al consumidor vayan a saltar, pero sugiere que la presión de costos en la economía de servicios sigue activa.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: Para los hogares, eso podría significar aumentos continuos de precios para servicios cotidianos.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: Para la Fed, es una prueba más de que el camino de regreso a una inflación estable puede no ser fluido.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: Seguir varias fuentes de datos a lo largo del tiempo, en lugar de depender de un solo número titular, ofrece la imagen más clara.

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: عندما يُظهر مسح تجاري يُتابع عن كثب أن تكاليف المدخلات ترتفع بأسرع وتيرة في أكثر من ثلاث سنوات، فإن الاقتصاديين ينتبهون.

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: جاءت أحدث قراءة لمؤشر "الأسعار المدفوعة" للخدمات الصادر عن معهد إدارة التوريد (ISM) عند 74، وهو أعلى مستوى له منذ منتصف عام 2022.

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: إنه تذكير بأن ضغوط التكاليف لم تتبدد تماماً للعديد من مقدمي الخدمات.

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: يوضح هذا المقال ماذا يعني هذا الرقم، وكيف يمكن أن يصل إلى ميزانية الأسرة اليومية، ولماذا يضيف إلى التحدي الذي يواجه الاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: هذا المقال توضيحي وليس نصيحة مالية.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## ما يقيسه مؤشر "الأسعار المدفوعة" الصادر عن معهد إدارة التوريد

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: يستطلع معهد إدارة التوريد (ISM) آراء مديري المشتريات والتوريد في قطاع الخدمات كل شهر.

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: يسأل أحد الأسئلة عما إذا كانت الأسعار التي يدفعونها مقابل المواد والإمدادات والخدمات أعلى أو أدنى أو دون تغيير مقارنة بالشهر السابق.

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **القراءة التي تزيد عن 50** تعني أن عدد المستجيبين الذين أبلغوا عن ارتفاع الأسعار أكبر من أولئك الذين أبلغوا عن انخفاضها.

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **القراءة التي تقل عن 50** تعني العكس.

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **كلما زادت القراءة عن 50، كلما كانت تقارير ارتفاع التكاليف أكثر انتشاراً.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: لذلك تشير القراءة البالغة 74 إلى أن غالبية كبيرة من الشركات التي شملها الاستطلاع تدفع أكثر مقابل ما تشتريه.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: ونظراً لأنه مؤشر انتشار، فهو يوضح مدى *اتساع* زيادات الأسعار، وليس مدى كبرها من حيث النسبة المئوية.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: القراءة المرتفعة تعني أن العديد من الشركات تشهد تكاليف أعلى، لكنها لا توضح المقدار الدقيق لذلك.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## لماذا يكتسب قطاع الخدمات هذه الأهمية الكبيرة

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: تشكل الخدمات الجزء الأكبر من الاقتصاد الأمريكي

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: ونسبة كبيرة مما تنفقه الأسر.

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: ويشمل ذلك تناول الطعام بالخارج، والرعاية الصحية، والتأمين، والنقل، والإقامة، وإصلاح المنازل، والعناية الشخصية، والخدمات المهنية.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: تميل تضخم الخدمات إلى أن يكون أكثر لزوجة من تضخم السلع.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: جزء كبير من تكلفة الخدمة هو العمالة، وعادة لا تنخفض الأجور بسرعة بمجرد أن ترتفع.

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: كما أن الإيجارات وأقساط التأمين وتسعير العقود تتكيف ببطء.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: نتيجة لذلك، عندما تتراكم ضغوط التكاليف في الخدمات، فقد يستغرق الأمر وقتاً طويلاً للخروج من النظام.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## من تكاليف الشركات إلى أسعار المستهلكين

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يصف الاقتصاديون "خط أنابيب" لضغوط الأسعار.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: ترتفع التكاليف في مرحلة ما، وتحدد الشركات مقدار تلك الزيادة التي ستتحملها ومقدار ما ستمرره.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: هناك عدة قنوات يمكنها ربط قراءة الأسعار المدفوعة بما يدفعه الأفراد:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **وجبات المطاعم.** تساهم مكونات الطعام، والتغليف، والطاقة، وأجور موظفي المطابخ وخدمة الطاولات في أسعار القائمة. وعندما ترتفع عدة عوامل من هذه العوامل معاً، قد يرفع أصحاب المطاعم الأسعار أو يقلصون حجم الوجبات.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **الإصلاحات والصيانة.** تؤثر قطع الغيار، والأدوات، وقود سيارات الخدمة، والعمالة الماهرة جميعها على فاتورة إصلاح السيارات، وخدمة الأجهزة، ومشاريع المنازل.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **التأمين والخدمات المهنية.** يمكن أن تظهر تكاليف المطالبات الأعلى ومصاريف التشغيل على شكل أقساط أو رسوم متزايدة وقت التجديد.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **السفر والإقامة.** يمكن أن تؤثر تكاليف الوقود، والتنظيف، والتوظيف، والصيانة على الأسعار وأسعار الغرف.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: نادراً ما يكون التمرير فورياً أو كاملاً.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: المنافسة، ومقاومة العملاء، وهامش ربح كل شركة تؤثر جميعها على مدى وصول زيادة التكاليف إلى السعر النهائي.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: تتحمل بعض الشركات التكاليف الأعلى لفترة من الوقت، بينما تتكيف شركات أخرى بسرعة.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب يُنظر إلى قراءة المسح على أفضل نحو باعتبارها إشارة مبكرة وليست توقعاً دقيقاً.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## لماذا يعقد ذلك مهمة الفيدرالي

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: يهدف الاحتياطي الفيدرالي إلى استقرار الأسعار وتحقيق أقصى قدر من التوظيف.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: يراقب صانعو السياسات العديد من مؤشرات التضخم، وتحظى أسعار الخدمات باهتمام خاص لأنها مستمرة المرونة وترتبط ارتباطاً وثيقاً بسوق العمل.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: تخلق قراءة الأسعار المدفوعة المرتفعة بعض الصعوبات:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **قد تبطئ التقدم المحرز في التضخم.** إذا واجهت الشركات تكاليف متزايدة، فقد تستمر في رفع الأسعار، مما يجعل إعادة التضخم إلى هدف الفيدرالي البالغ 2% أمراً أكثر صعوبة.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **يضيق المجال لتخفيف السياسة النقدية.** يمكن أن تدعم أسعار الفائدة المنخفضة النمو والتوظيف، لكنها قد تبقي أيضاً الطلب والأسعار مرتفعة. تجعل إشارة التكاليف المرتفعة المسؤولين أكثر حذراً بشأن خفض أسعار الفائدة.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **ترسل إشارات متباينة.** إذا كان النمو أو التوظيف يهدأ في نفس الوقت الذي ترتفع فيه التكاليف، يواجه صانعو السياسات مقايضة بين دعم الوظائف وcontainment الأسعار.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: لا يوجد مسح واحد يوجه السياسة وحدها.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: ينظر الفيدرالي إلى بيانات التضخم الرسمية مثل مؤشر أسعار المستهلك ومؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي، إلى جانب أرقام التوظيف، ونمو الأجور، وتوقعات التضخم.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: مع ذلك، تتسم بيانات معهد إدارة التوريد في الوقت المناسب ويتم نشرها قبل العديد من التقارير الحكومية، لذا يمكنها صياغة التوقعات حول ما ستظهره تلك التقارير.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## محاذير يجب وضعها في الاعتبار

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **الاستطلاعات ليست بيانات صلبة.** يعكس مؤشر معهد إدارة التوريد آراء مديري المشتريات، ويمكن أن تكون القراءات الشهرية متقلبة.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **شهر واحد لا يمثل اتجاهاً.** يرغب الاقتصاديون عموماً في معرفة ما إذا كانت القراءة ستظل مرتفعة على مدار عدة أشهر.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **ضغوط التكاليف لا تماثل تضخم المستهلكين.** قد تتحمل بعض الشركات الزيادات، ويمكن أن تتحرك مؤشرات الأسعار الرسمية بشكل مختلف عن نتائج المسح.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **عوامل أخرى يمكن أن تشوه القراءات.** أسعار الطاقة، أو السياسة التجارية، أو الأحداث المناخية، أو اضطرابات الإمدادات يمكن أن ترفع التكاليف مؤقتاً دون تغيير الصورة على المدى الطويل.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: سيبحث المحللون عن تأكيد في عدة أماكن:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - تقرير خدمات معهد إدارة التوريد القادم، لمعرفة ما إذا كانت الأسعار المدفوعة ستظل مرتفعة أم ستتراجع.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - بيانات التضخم الرسمية لمؤشر أسعار المستهلك ومؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي، لا سيما فئات الخدمات.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - نمو الأجور وتقارير سوق العمل.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - تعليقات مسؤولي الفيدرالي حول كيفية تقييمهم للبيانات الأخيرة.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: لا تضمن قراءة الأسعار المدفوعة البالغة 74 قفزة أسعار المستهلكين، لكنها تشير إلى أن ضغوط التكاليف في اقتصاد الخدمات لا تزال نشطة.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأسر، قد يعني ذلك استمرار ارتفاع أسعار الخدمات اليومية.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للفيدرالي، يعد ذلك دليلاً إضافياً على أن الطريق للعودة إلى التضخم المستقر قد لا يكون سلساً.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: إن متابعة مصادر بيانات متعددة بمرور الوقت، بدلاً من الاعتماد على رقم رئيسي واحد، يمنح الصورة الأوضح.

segments.tr: *هذا المقال مخصص للمعلومات العامة فقط ولا يشكل نصيحة مالية أو استثمارية أو اقتصادية.*

fr.title: Un indicateur des prix des services à 74 : pourquoi l'indice des « prix payés » de l'ISM retient toute l'attention des économistes

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'une enquête de conjoncture très suivie montre que les coûts des intrants augmentent à leur rythme le plus rapide depuis plus de trois ans, les économistes y prêtent attention.

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: La dernière lecture de l'indice des « prix payés » des services de l'Institute for Supply Management (ISM) s'est établie à 74, son niveau le plus élevé depuis la mi-2022.

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: C'est un rappel que les pressions sur les coûts n'ont pas totalement disparu pour de nombreux prestataires de services.

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce que signifie ce chiffre, comment il peut se répercuter sur les budgets des ménages au quotidien, et pourquoi il s'ajoute au défi auquel est confrontée la Réserve fédérale.

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'un article explicatif et non d'un conseil financier.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## Ce que mesure l'indice des « prix payés » de l'ISM

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: L'ISM interroge chaque mois des responsables des achats et des approvisionnements dans l'ensemble du secteur des services.

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: Une question demande si les prix qu'ils paient pour les matériaux, les fournitures et les services sont plus élevés, plus bas ou inchangés par rapport au mois précédent.

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **Une lecture supérieure à 50** signifie que davantage de répondants signalent des prix en hausse plutôt qu'en baisse.

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **Une lecture inférieure à 50** signifie le contraire.

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **Plus l'indice dépasse 50, plus les signalements de hausse des coûts sont généralisés.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: Une lecture de 74 signale donc qu'une grande majorité des entreprises interrogées paient plus cher ce qu'elles achètent.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: Puisqu'il s'agit d'un indice de diffusion, il montre à quel point les hausses de prix sont *généralisées*, et non leur ampleur en pourcentage.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: Un chiffre élevé signifie que de nombreuses entreprises constatent des coûts plus élevés, mais il ne précise pas exactement de combien.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le secteur des services est si important

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: Les services constituent l'essentiel de l'économie américaine

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: et une part importante des dépenses des ménages.

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: Cela comprend la restauration, la santé, l'assurance, les transports, l'hébergement, les réparations domiciliaires, les soins personnels et les services professionnels.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: L'inflation des services a tendance à être plus persistante que l'inflation des biens.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: Une grande partie du coût d'un service est liée à la main-d'œuvre, et les salaires ne baissent généralement pas rapidement une fois qu'ils ont augmenté.

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: Les loyers, les primes d'assurance et les tarifs contractuels s'ajustent également lentement.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: Par conséquent, lorsque la pression sur les coûts s'accumule dans les services, cela peut prendre beaucoup de temps pour s'estomper du système.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## Des coûts des entreprises aux prix à la consommation

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: Les économistes décrivent souvent une « chaîne de transmission » de la pression sur les prix.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: Les coûts augmentent à une étape, et les entreprises décident de la part de cette augmentation qu'elles vont absorber et de celle qu'elles vont répercuter.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: Plusieurs canaux peuvent lier un indice élevé des prix payés à ce que les gens paient :

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **Les repas au restaurant.** Les ingrédients alimentaires, l'emballage, l'énergie et les salaires du personnel de cuisine et de salle entrent tous dans le prix des menus. Lorsque plusieurs de ces éléments augmentent ensemble, les propriétaires peuvent augmenter les prix ou réduire les portions.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **Les réparations et l'entretien.** Les pièces, les outils, le carburant pour les véhicules de service et la main-d'œuvre qualifiée affectent tous la facture des réparations automobiles, de l'entretien des appareils électroménagers et des projets résidentiels.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **Les assurances et services professionnels.** Des coûts de sinistres et des dépenses d'exploitation plus élevés peuvent se traduire par une augmentation des primes ou des honoraires lors du renouvellement.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **Les voyages et l'hébergement.** Les coûts du carburant, du nettoyage, du personnel et de l'entretien peuvent influencer les tarifs des billets et des chambres.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: La répercussion est rarement immédiate ou complète.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: La concurrence, la résistance des clients et la marge bénéficiaire de chaque entreprise affectent la part de la hausse des coûts qui atteint le prix final.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: Certaines entreprises absorbent les coûts plus élevés pendant un certain temps, tandis que d'autres s'ajustent rapidement.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi le résultat d'une enquête doit plutôt être considéré comme un signal précoce que comme une prévision précise.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela complique la tâche de la Fed

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: La Réserve fédérale vise la stabilité des prix et le plein emploi.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques surveillent de nombreux indicateurs d'inflation, et les prix des services font l'objet d'une attention particulière car ils sont persistants et étroitement liés au marché du travail.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: Un indice des prix payés élevé crée quelques difficultés :

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **Cela peut ralentir les progrès sur l'inflation.** Si les entreprises font face à des coûts croissants, elles peuvent continuer à augmenter leurs prix, ce qui rend plus difficile le retour de l'inflation vers l'objectif de 2% de la Fed.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **Cela réduit la marge de manœuvre pour assouplir la politique.** Des taux d'intérêt plus bas peuvent soutenir la croissance et l'emploi, mais ils peuvent aussi maintenir la demande et les prix à un niveau élevé. Un signal de coûts élevés rend les responsables plus prudents quant à la baisse des taux.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **Cela envoie des signaux contradictoires.** Si la croissance ou l'emploi ralentissent en même temps que les coûts augmentent, les décideurs politiques sont confrontés à un arbitrage entre le soutien à l'emploi et la maîtrise des prix.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: Aucune enquête isolée ne dicte la politique.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: La Fed examine les données officielles sur l'inflation telles que l'indice des prix à la consommation (CPI) et l'indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE), ainsi que les chiffres de l'emploi, la croissance des salaires et les attentes d'inflation.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, les données de l'ISM sont publiées rapidement et avant de nombreux rapports gouvernementaux, de sorte qu'elles peuvent façonner les attentes quant à ce que ces rapports montreront.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## Mises en garde à garder à l'esprit

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **Les enquêtes ne sont pas des données concrètes.** L'indice ISM reflète les opinions des directeurs d'achat, et les résultats mensuels peuvent être volatils.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **Un mois ne fait pas une tendance.** Les économistes cherchent généralement à voir si l'indice reste élevé sur plusieurs mois.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **La pression sur les coûts n'est pas identique à l'inflation à la consommation.** Certaines entreprises peuvent absorber les hausses, et les indices de prix officiels peuvent évoluer différemment des résultats d'enquêtes.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **D'autres facteurs peuvent fausser les résultats.** Les prix de l'énergie, la politique commerciale, les événements météorologiques ou les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement peuvent temporairement faire grimper les coûts sans modifier la tendance à plus long terme.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: Les analystes chercheront confirmation dans plusieurs domaines :

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - Le prochain rapport ISM sur les services, pour voir si les prix payés restent élevés ou s'essoufflent.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - Les données officielles sur l'inflation CPI et PCE, en particulier les catégories de services.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - La croissance des salaires et les rapports sur le marché du travail.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - Les commentaires des responsables de la Fed sur la manière dont ils évaluent les données récentes.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: Un indice des prix payés à 74 ne garantit pas que les prix à la consommation vont bondir, mais il suggère que la pression sur les coûts dans l'économie des services est toujours active.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages, cela pourrait signifier des hausses de prix continues pour les services du quotidien.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: Pour la Fed, c'est une preuve de plus que le chemin du retour vers une inflation stable pourrait ne pas être sans embûches.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: Suivre plusieurs sources de données au fil du temps, plutôt que de s'en remettre à un seul chiffre clé, donne l'image la plus claire.
