pt.title: Um Indicador de Preços de Serviços a 74: Por que a Leitura de "Preços Pagos" do ISM Tem Deixado os Economistas em Alerta

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: Quando uma pesquisa empresarial amplamente acompanhada mostra custos de insumos subindo no ritmo mais rápido em mais de três anos, os economistas prestam atenção.

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: A leitura mais recente do índice de "preços pagos" do setor de serviços do Institute for Supply Management (ISM) ficou em 74, seu nível mais alto desde meados de 2022.

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: É um lembrete de que as pressões de custos não desapareceram totalmente para muitos provedores de serviços.

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica o que o número significa, como ele pode chegar aos orçamentos domésticos diários e por que ele aumenta o desafio enfrentado pelo Federal Reserve.

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Este é um artigo explicativo, não uma recomendação financeira.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## O que o Índice de "Preços Pagos" do ISM Mede

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: O ISM pesquisa executivos de compras e suprimentos em todo o setor de serviços todos os meses.

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: Uma pergunta pergunta se os preços que eles pagam por materiais, suprimentos e serviços estão mais altos, mais baixos ou inalterados em comparação com o mês anterior.

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **Uma leitura acima de 50** significa que mais entrevistados relatam preços em alta do que preços em queda.

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **Uma leitura abaixo de 50** significa o oposto.

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **Quanto mais acima de 50, mais generalizados são os relatos de custos em alta.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: Uma leitura de 74, portanto, sinaliza que uma ampla maioria das empresas pesquisadas está pagando mais pelo que compra.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: Por ser um índice de difusão, ele mostra quão *amplos* são os aumentos de preços, e não quão grandes eles são em termos percentuais.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: Uma leitura alta significa que muitas empresas estão vendo custos mais altos, mas não diz exatamente em quanto.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Por que o Setor de Serviços Importa Tanto

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: Os serviços compõem a maior parte da economia dos EUA

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: e uma grande parcela do que as famílias gastam.

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: Isso inclui refeições fora de casa, saúde, seguros, transporte, hospedagem, reparos residenciais, cuidados pessoais e serviços profissionais.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: A inflação de serviços tende a ser mais rígida do que a inflação de bens.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: Uma grande parte do custo de um serviço é a mão de obra, e os salários geralmente não caem rapidamente após subirem.

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: Aluguéis, prêmios de seguro e preços de contratos também se ajustam lentamente.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: Como resultado, quando a pressão de custos se acumula nos serviços, pode levar muito tempo para sair do sistema.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## Dos Custos Empresariais aos Preços ao Consumidor

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: Os economistas costumam descrever um "canal" de pressão de preços.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: Os custos sobem em um estágio, e as empresas decidem quanto desse aumento absorver e quanto repassar.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: Vários canais podem conectar uma leitura alta de preços pagos ao que as pessoas pagam:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **Refeições em restaurantes.** Ingredientes de alimentos, embalagens, energia e salários de funcionários de cozinha e atendimento alimentam os preços do cardápio. Quando vários deles sobem juntos, os proprietários podem subir os preços ou reduzir as porções.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **Reparos e manutenção.** Peças, ferramentas, combustível para veículos de serviço e mão de obra qualificada afetam a conta de reparos de carros, serviços de eletrodomésticos e projetos domésticos.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **Seguros e serviços profissionais.** Maiores custos de sinistros e despesas operacionais podem aparecer como prêmios ou taxas aumentadas na época da renovação.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **Viagens e hospedagem.** Custos de combustível, limpeza, pessoal e manutenção podem influenciar tarifas e taxas de quartos.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: O repasse raramente é imediato ou completo.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: A concorrência, a resistência do cliente e a margem de lucro de cada empresa afetam quanto de um aumento de custo chega ao preço final.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: Algumas empresas absorvem custos mais altos por um tempo, enquanto outras se ajustam rapidamente.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: É por isso que a leitura de uma pesquisa é melhor vista como um sinal antecipado do que como uma previsão precisa.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## Por que Isso Complica o Trabalho do Fed

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: O Federal Reserve visa preços estáveis e emprego máximo.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: Os formuladores de políticas acompanham muitos indicadores de inflação, e os preços de serviços recebem atenção especial porque são persistentes e estão intimamente ligados ao mercado de trabalho.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: Uma leitura alta de preços pagos cria algumas dificuldades:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **Pode desacelerar o progresso na inflação.** Se as empresas enfrentam custos crescentes, elas podem continuar subindo os preços, o que dificulta trazer a inflação de volta à meta de 2% do Fed.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **Estreita a margem para flexibilização da política.** Taxas de juros mais baixas podem apoiar o crescimento e a contratação, mas também podem manter a demanda e os preços elevados. Um sinal de custo alto torna as autoridades mais cautelosas sobre cortar taxas.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **Envia sinais mistos.** Se o crescimento ou a contratação estiver esfriando ao mesmo tempo em que os custos estão subindo, os formuladores de políticas enfrentam uma compensação entre apoiar empregos e conter preços.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: Nenhuma pesquisa isolada direciona a política.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: O Fed analisa dados oficiais de inflação, como o Índice de Preços ao Consumidor e o índice de preços de Despesas de Consumo Pessoal, juntamente com números de emprego, crescimento salarial e expectativas de inflação.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, os dados do ISM são oportunos e publicados antes de muitos relatórios governamentais, podendo moldar expectativas sobre o que esses relatórios mostrarão.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## Advertências que Vale a Pena Ter em Mente

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **Pesquisas não são dados rígidos.** O índice ISM reflete as opiniões de gerentes de compras, e as leituras mensais podem ser voláteis.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **Um mês não é uma tendência.** Os economistas geralmente querem ver se a leitura permanece elevada por vários meses.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **Pressão de custo não é o mesmo que inflação ao consumidor.** Algumas empresas podem absorver aumentos, e os índices de preços oficiais podem se mover de maneira diferente dos resultados da pesquisa.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **Outros fatores podem distorcer as leituras.** Preços de energia, política comercial, eventos climáticos ou interrupções na cadeia de suprimentos podem elevar temporariamente os custos sem alterar o panorama de longo prazo.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## O que Acompanhar a Seguir

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: Os analistas procurarão confirmação em vários lugares:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - O próximo relatório de serviços do ISM, para ver se os preços pagos continuam altos ou diminuem.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - Dados oficiais de inflação do IPC e do PCE, particularmente as categorias de serviços.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - Relatórios de crescimento salarial e do mercado de trabalho.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - Comentários de autoridades do Fed sobre como estão avaliando os dados recentes.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: Uma leitura de preços pagos de 74 não garante que os preços ao consumidor vão disparar, mas sugere que a pressão de custos na economia de serviços ainda está ativa.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: Para as famílias, isso pode significar aumentos contínuos de preços para serviços diários.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: Para o Fed, é mais uma evidência de que o caminho de volta à inflação estável pode não ser tranquilo.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: Acompanhar várias fontes de dados ao longo do tempo, em vez de confiar em um único número de manchete, oferece o quadro mais claro.

segments.tr: Sewa, premi asuransi, dan harga kontrak juga menyesuaikan secara perlahan.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: Akibatnya, ketika tekanan biaya menumpuk di sektor jasa, butuh waktu lama untuk keluar dari sistem.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## Dari Biaya Bisnis ke Harga Konsumen

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: Para ekonom sering menggambarkan "saluran" tekanan harga.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: Biaya naik di satu tahap, dan bisnis memutuskan seberapa banyak kenaikan tersebut yang akan diserap dan seberapa banyak yang akan diteruskan.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: Beberapa saluran dapat menghubungkan angka harga yang dibayar yang tinggi dengan apa yang dibayar masyarakat:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **Makanan restoran.** Bahan makanan, kemasan, energi, serta upah staf dapur dan pelayan semuanya memengaruhi harga menu. Ketika beberapa hal ini naik bersamaan, pemilik mungkin menaikkan harga atau memperkecil porsi.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **Perbaikan dan pemeliharaan.** Suku cadang, peralatan, bahan bakar untuk kendaraan operasional, dan tenaga kerja terampil semuanya memengaruhi tagihan perbaikan mobil, servis peralatan, dan proyek rumah.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **Asuransi dan jasa profesional.** Biaya klaim dan biaya operasional yang lebih tinggi dapat muncul sebagai kenaikan premi atau biaya pada saat perpanjangan.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **Perjalanan dan penginapan.** Biaya bahan bakar, pembersihan, staf, dan pemeliharaan dapat memengaruhi tarif tiket dan harga kamar.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: Penerusan biaya ini jarang terjadi secara langsung atau sepenuhnya.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: Persaingan, penolakan pelanggan, dan margin keuntungan masing-masing perusahaan semuanya memengaruhi seberapa besar kenaikan biaya mencapai harga akhir.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: Beberapa bisnis menyerap biaya yang lebih tinggi untuk sementara waktu, sementara yang lain menyesuaikan dengan cepat.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: Itulah mengapa angka survei paling baik dilihat sebagai sinyal awal daripada perkiraan yang tepat.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Ini Mempersulit Tugas Fed

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: Federal Reserve menargetkan harga yang stabil dan lapangan kerja maksimum.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: Para pembuat kebijakan memantau banyak indikator inflasi, dan harga jasa menerima perhatian khusus karena mereka persisten dan terkait erat dengan pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: Angka harga yang dibayar yang tinggi menciptakan beberapa kesulitan:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **Ini dapat memperlambat kemajuan inflasi.** Jika bisnis menghadapi kenaikan biaya, mereka mungkin terus menaikkan harga, yang membuatnya lebih sulit untuk membawa inflasi kembali ke target 2% dari Fed.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **Ini mempersempit ruang untuk melonggarkan kebijakan.** Suku bunga yang lebih rendah dapat mendukung pertumbuhan dan perekrutan, tetapi mereka juga dapat menjaga permintaan dan harga tetap tinggi. Sinyal biaya yang panas membuat para pejabat lebih berhati-hati dalam memotong suku bunga.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **Ini mengirimkan sinyal yang beragam.** Jika pertumbuhan atau perekrutan mendingin pada saat yang sama ketika biaya naik, para pembuat kebijakan menghadapi dilema antara mendukung lapangan kerja dan mengendalikan harga.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu survei pun yang mendorong kebijakan.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Fed melihat data inflasi resmi seperti Indeks Harga Konsumen (CPI) dan indeks harga Pengeluaran Konsumsi Pribadi (PCE), bersama dengan angka ketenagakerjaan, pertumbuhan upah, dan ekspektasi inflasi.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: Namun, data ISM tepat waktu dan diterbitkan sebelum banyak laporan pemerintah, sehingga dapat membentuk ekspektasi tentang apa yang akan ditunjukkan oleh laporan-laporan tersebut.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## Catatan Penting yang Perlu Diingat

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **Survei bukanlah data pasti.** Indeks ISM mencerminkan opini para manajer pembelian, dan angka bulanan bisa bergejolak.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **Satu bulan bukanlah tren.** Para ekonom umumnya ingin melihat apakah angka tersebut tetap tinggi selama beberapa bulan.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **Tekanan biaya tidak sama dengan inflasi konsumen.** Beberapa perusahaan mungkin menyerap kenaikan, dan indeks harga resmi dapat bergerak berbeda dari hasil survei.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **Faktor lain dapat mendistorsi angka.** Harga energi, kebijakan perdagangan, peristiwa cuaca, atau gangguan pasokan dapat menaikkan biaya untuk sementara tanpa mengubah gambaran jangka panjang.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan Selanjutnya

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: Para analis akan mencari konfirmasi di beberapa tempat:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - Laporan jasa ISM berikutnya, untuk melihat apakah harga yang dibayar tetap tinggi atau mereda.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - Data inflasi CPI dan PCE resmi, khususnya kategori jasa.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - Laporan pertumbuhan upah dan pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - Komentar dari para pejabat Fed tentang bagaimana mereka menimbang data terbaru.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: Angka harga yang dibayar sebesar 74 tidak menjamin bahwa harga konsumen akan melonjak, tetapi ini menunjukkan bahwa tekanan biaya dalam ekonomi jasa masih aktif.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: Bagi rumah tangga, itu bisa berarti kenaikan harga yang berkelanjutan untuk jasa sehari-hari.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: Bagi Fed, ini adalah satu lagi bukti bahwa jalan kembali ke inflasi yang stabil mungkin tidak mulus.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: Mengikuti beberapa sumber data dari waktu ke waktu, daripada mengandalkan satu angka utama, memberikan gambaran yang paling jelas.

ja.title: 74を記録したサービス価格指標：ISM「支払価格」指数が経済学者の注目を集める理由

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: 広く注目されているビジネス調査で、投入コストが3年以上ぶりの速さで上昇していることが示されると、経済学者は注視します。

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: 米供給管理協会（ISM）による最新のサービス業「支払価格」指数は74となり、2022年半ば以来の高水準を記録しました。

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: これは、多くのサービス提供者にとってコスト圧力が完全には消えていないことを思い起こさせるものです。

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: この記事では、この数値が何を意味するのか、どのように日々の家計に影響を及ぼし得るのか、そしてなぜ連邦準備制度（FRB）が直面する課題を増大させるのかを解説します。

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: これは解説記事であり、金融アドバイスではありません。

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## ISM「支払価格」指数が測定するもの

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: ISMは毎月、サービス部門の購買・供給担当役員を対象に調査を行っています。

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: ある質問では、材料、供給品、サービスに対して支払う価格が前月と比較して上昇したか、低下したか、あるいは変わらないかを尋ねています。

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **50を上回る数値**は、価格が低下したと回答した人よりも上昇したと回答した人の方が多いことを意味します。

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **50を下回る数値**はその逆を意味します。

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **50から離れるほど、コスト上昇の報告が広範囲に及んでいることを示します。**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: したがって、74という数値は、調査対象企業の大多数が購入するものに対してより高い金額を支払っていることを示唆しています。

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: これは拡散指数であるため、価格上昇がどれほど「広範囲」であるかを示すものであり、パーセンテージでどれほど大きいかを示すものではありません。

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: 高い数値は多くの企業がコスト上昇に直面していることを意味しますが、正確にどれくらい上昇しているかまでは示していません。

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## なぜサービス部門がこれほど重要なのか

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: サービス業は米国経済の大部分を占めており、

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: 家計支出の大きな割合を占めています。

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: これには外食、医療、保険、交通、宿泊、住宅修理、パーソナルケア、専門サービスなどが含まれます。

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: サービスインフレは、財のインフレよりも粘着性が高い傾向があります。

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: サービスコストの大部分は労働力であり、賃金は一度上昇するとすぐには下がらないのが通常です。

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: 家賃、保険料、契約価格もゆっくりとしか調整されません。

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: その結果、サービス部門でコスト圧力が強まると、それがシステムから解消されるまでに長い時間がかかる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## ビジネスコストから消費者物価へ

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: 経済学者はよく、価格圧力の「パイプライン」について説明します。

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: ある段階でコストが上昇すると、企業はその上昇分をどれだけ吸収し、どれだけ転嫁するかを決定します。

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: 高い支払価格指数が人々の支払う価格と結びつく経路はいくつかあります。

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **レストランでの食事。** 食材、包装、エネルギー、キッチンスタッフや接客スタッフの賃金はすべてメニュー価格に反映されます。これらが同時に上昇すると、オーナーは価格を上げるか、量を減らす可能性があります。

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **修理とメンテナンス。** 部品、工具、サービス車両の燃料、熟練労働力はすべて、自動車修理、家電サービス、住宅プロジェクトの請求額に影響を与えます。

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **保険と専門サービス。** 保険金請求コストや運営費の上昇は、更新時の保険料や手数料の値上げとして現れることがあります。

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **旅行と宿泊。** 燃料、清掃、人員配置、メンテナンスコストは、運賃や宿泊料金に影響を与える可能性があります。

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: 価格転嫁が即座に行われたり、完全に行われたりすることは稀です。

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: 競争、顧客の抵抗、各企業の利益率が、コスト上昇分が最終価格にどれだけ反映されるかに影響を与えます。

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: コスト上昇をしばらく吸収する企業もあれば、すぐに調整する企業もあります。

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: そのため、調査結果は正確な予測というよりも、早期のシグナルとして捉えるのが最適です。

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## なぜFRBの仕事を複雑にするのか

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 連邦準備制度（FRB）は、物価の安定と雇用の最大化を目指しています。

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: 政策立案者は多くのインフレ指標を注視しており、サービス価格は持続性が高く労働市場と密接に関連しているため、特に注目されています。

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: 高い支払価格指数は、いくつかの困難を生じさせます。

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **インフレ抑制の進展を遅らせる可能性がある。** 企業がコスト上昇に直面すれば、価格を引き上げ続ける可能性があり、インフレをFRBの目標である2%に戻すことが難しくなります。

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **政策緩和の余地を狭める。** 金利の引き下げは成長と雇用を支えることができますが、需要と物価を高止まりさせる可能性もあります。コスト上昇のシグナルが強いと、当局は利下げに対してより慎重になります。

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **混在したシグナルを送る。** コストが上昇している一方で成長や雇用が冷え込んでいる場合、政策立案者は雇用の維持と物価の抑制というトレードオフに直面します。

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: 単一の調査だけで政策が決まるわけではありません。

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: FRBは、消費者物価指数（CPI）や個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数といった公式のインフレデータに加え、雇用統計、賃金の伸び、インフレ期待を注視しています。

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: それでも、ISMデータはタイムリーであり、多くの政府報告書よりも先に発表されるため、それらの報告書が何を示すかについての期待を形成する可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## 心に留めておくべき注意点

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **調査はハードデータではない。** ISM指数は購買担当者の意見を反映したものであり、月次の数値は変動する可能性があります。

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **1ヶ月の数値はトレンドではない。** 経済学者は一般的に、その数値が数ヶ月にわたって高止まりするかどうかを確認したいと考えます。

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **コスト圧力は消費者インフレと同じではない。** コスト上昇を吸収する企業もあり、公式の物価指数は調査結果とは異なる動きをすることがあります。

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **他の要因が数値を歪める可能性がある。** エネルギー価格、貿易政策、気象イベント、供給の混乱などは、長期的な見通しを変えることなく一時的にコストを押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の注目点

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: アナリストは、いくつかの場所で確認を求めるでしょう：

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - 次回のISMサービス業報告書で、支払価格が高止まりするか、緩和するか。

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - 公式のCPIおよびPCEインフレデータ、特にサービス部門のカテゴリー。

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - 賃金の伸びと労働市場の報告。

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - 最近のデータをどのように評価しているかについてのFRB当局者のコメント。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: 74という支払価格指数は、消費者物価が急騰することを保証するものではありませんが、サービス経済におけるコスト圧力が依然として活発であることを示唆しています。

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: 家計にとっては、日々のサービス価格が上昇し続けることを意味する可能性があります。

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: FRBにとっては、安定したインフレへの道のりが平坦ではないことを示す証拠が一つ増えたことになります。

de.title: Ein Dienstleistungs-Preisindikator bei 74: Warum der ISM-"Prices Paid"-Wert Ökonomen genau hinsehen lässt

segments.src: When a closely followed business survey shows input costs climbing at the fastest pace in more than three years, economists pay attention.
segments.tr: Wenn eine viel beachtete Unternehmensumfrage zeigt, dass die Vorleistungskosten so schnell steigen wie seit mehr als drei Jahren nicht mehr, werden Ökonomen aufmerksam.

segments.src: The latest reading of the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) services "prices paid" index came in at 74, its highest level since mid-2022.
segments.tr: Der jüngste Wert des Institute for Supply Management (ISM) für den Index der gezahlten Preise im Dienstleistungssektor ("prices paid") lag bei 74 und damit auf dem höchsten Stand seit Mitte 2022.

segments.src: It is a reminder that cost pressures have not fully faded for many service providers.
segments.tr: Dies ist eine Erinnerung daran, dass der Kostendruck für viele Dienstleister noch nicht vollständig abgeklungen ist.

segments.src: This article explains what the number means, how it can reach everyday household budgets, and why it adds to the challenge facing the Federal Reserve.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erklärt, was diese Zahl bedeutet, wie sie sich auf die alltäglichen Haushaltsbudgets auswirken kann und warum sie die Herausforderungen für die US-Notenbank Federal Reserve erhöht.

segments.src: It is an explainer, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Dies ist eine Erläuterung und keine Finanzberatung.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures
segments.tr: ## Was der ISM-"Prices Paid"-Index misst

segments.src: The ISM surveys purchasing and supply executives across the services sector each month.
segments.tr: Das ISM befragt jeden Monat Einkaufs- und Logistikleiter im gesamten Dienstleistungssektor.

segments.src: One question asks whether the prices they pay for materials, supplies, and services are higher, lower, or unchanged compared with the prior month.
segments.tr: Eine Frage zielt darauf ab, ob die von ihnen für Materialien, Vorräte und Dienstleistungen gezahlten Preise im Vergleich zum Vormonat gestiegen, gesunken oder unverändert geblieben sind.

segments.src: - **A reading above 50** means more respondents report rising prices than falling prices.
segments.tr: - **Ein Wert über 50** bedeutet, dass mehr Befragte von steigenden als von fallenden Preisen berichten.

segments.src: - **A reading below 50** means the opposite.
segments.tr: - **Ein Wert unter 50** bedeutet das Gegenteil.

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **Je weiter er über 50 liegt, desto verbreiteter sind die Berichte über steigende Kosten.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: Ein Wert von 74 signalisiert daher, dass eine große Mehrheit der befragten Unternehmen für ihre Einkäufe mehr bezahlt.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: Da es sich um einen Diffusionsindex handelt, zeigt er, wie *breit* die Preiserhöhungen sind, und nicht, wie groß sie prozentual ausfallen.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: Ein hoher Wert bedeutet, dass viele Unternehmen höhere Kosten verzeichnen, besagt aber nicht genau, um wie viel.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Warum der Dienstleistungssektor so wichtig ist

segments.src: Services make up the bulk of the U.S.
segments.tr: Dienstleistungen machen den größten Teil der US-

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: Wirtschaft aus und bestreiten einen großen Anteil der Konsumausgaben von Haushalten.

segments.src: That includes dining out, healthcare, insurance, transportation, lodging, home repair, personal care, and professional services.
segments.tr: Dazu gehören Restaurantbesuche, das Gesundheitswesen, Versicherungen, Transport, Unterkünfte, Hausreparaturen, Körperpflege und professionelle Dienstleistungen.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: Die Dienstleistungsinflation neigt dazu, hartnäckiger zu sein als die Güterinflation.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: Ein großer Teil der Kosten einer Dienstleistung entfällt auf Arbeitskräfte, und die Löhne sinken in der Regel nicht so schnell wieder, wenn sie erst einmal gestiegen sind.

segments.src: Rent, insurance premiums, and contract pricing also adjust slowly.
segments.tr: Mieten, Versicherungsprämien und Vertragspreise passen sich ebenfalls nur langsam an.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: Wenn sich im Dienstleistungssektor daher Kostendruck aufbaut, kann es lange dauern, bis dieser wieder aus dem System verschwindet.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## Von den Unternehmensosten zu den Verbraucherpreisen

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: Ökonomen sprechen oft von einer "Pipeline" des Preisdrucks.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: Die Kosten steigen auf einer Stufe, und die Unternehmen entscheiden, welchen Teil dieser Erhöhung sie auffangen und welchen sie weitergeben.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: Mehrere Kanäle können einen hohen Index der gezahlten Preise mit dem verknüpfen, was die Verbraucher zahlen:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **Restaurantbesuche.** Lebensmittelzutaten, Verpackungen, Energie sowie die Löhne für Küchen- und Servicepersonal fließen in die Menüpreise ein. Wenn mehrere dieser Faktoren gleichzeitig steigen, erhöhen die Besitzer möglicherweise die Preise oder verringern die Portionsgrößen.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **Reparaturen und Wartung.** Ersatzteile, Werkzeuge, Treibstoff für Servicefahrzeuge und qualifizierte Arbeitskräfte wirken sich auf die Rechnung für Autoreparaturen, Geräteservice und Heimwerkerprojekte aus.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **Versicherungen und professionelle Dienstleistungen.** Höhere Schadenskosten und Betriebsausgaben können sich bei Verlängerungen in erhöhten Prämien oder Gebühren niederschlagen.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **Reisen und Unterkünfte.** Treibstoff-, Reinigungs-, Personal- und Wartungskosten können Fahrpreise und Zimmerpreise beeinflussen.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: Die Weitergabe an die Kunden erfolgt selten unmittelbar oder vollständig.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: Wettbewerb, Kundenwiderstand und die Gewinnmarge jedes Unternehmens beeinflussen, wie viel einer Kostenerhöhung im Endpreis ankommt.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: Einige Unternehmen fangen höhere Kosten eine Zeit lang auf, während andere sich schnell anpassen.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: Deshalb ist ein Umfragewert eher als frühes Signal denn als präzise Prognose zu betrachten.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## Warum dies die Arbeit der Fed komplizierter macht

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: Die US-Notenbank Federal Reserve strebt stabile Preise und maximale Beschäftigung an.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: Die Währungshüter beobachten viele Inflationsindikatoren, wobei den Preisen im Dienstleistungssektor besondere Aufmerksamkeit geschenkt wird, da sie hartnäckig sind und eng mit dem Arbeitsmarkt zusammenhängen.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: Ein hoher Wert bei den gezahlten Preisen bringt einige Schwierigkeiten mit sich:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **Er kann die Fortschritte bei der Inflation verlangsamen.** Wenn Unternehmen mit steigenden Kosten konfrontiert sind, erhöhen sie möglicherweise weiterhin die Preise, was es schwieriger macht, die Inflation wieder auf das 2%-Ziel der Fed zurückzuführen.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **Er verringert den Spielraum für eine Lockerung der Geldpolitik.** Niedrigere Zinssätze können das Wachstum und die Einstellung von Mitarbeitern unterstützen, aber sie können auch die Nachfrage und die Preise hoch halten. Ein starkes Kostensignal macht die Offiziellen vorsichtiger bei Zinssenkungen.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **Er sendet widersprüchliche Signale.** Wenn sich das Wachstum oder die Einstellung von Arbeitskräften abkühlt, während gleichzeitig die Kosten steigen, stehen die Entscheidungsträger vor einem Zielkonflikt zwischen der Unterstützung von Arbeitsplätzen und der Eindämmung von Preisen.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: Keine einzelne Umfrage steuert die Politik allein.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Die Fed stützt sich auf offizielle Inflationsdaten wie den Verbraucherpreisindex und den Preisindex für die persönlichen Konsumausgaben sowie auf Beschäftigungszahlen, Lohnwachstum und Inflationserwartungen.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: Dennoch sind die ISM-Daten aktuell und werden vor vielen Regierungsberichten veröffentlicht, so dass sie die Erwartungen darüber prägen können, was diese Berichte zeigen werden.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## Wichtige Einschränkungen, die man im Hinterkopf behalten sollte

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **Umfragen sind keine harten Daten.** Der ISM-Index spiegelt die Meinungen von Einkaufsleitern wider, und monatliche Werte können volatil sein.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **Ein Monat ist kein Trend.** Ökonomen wollen im Allgemeinen sehen, ob der Wert über mehrere Monate hinweg erhöht bleibt.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **Kostendruck ist nicht dasselbe wie Verbraucherinflation.** Einige Unternehmen absorbieren möglicherweise Erhöhungen, und offizielle Preisindizes können sich anders entwickeln als die Umfrageergebnisse.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **Andere Faktoren können die Werte verzerren.** Energiepreise, Handelspolitik, Wetterereignisse oder Unterbrechungen der Lieferkette können die Kosten vorübergehend in die Höhe treiben, ohne das längerfristige Bild zu verändern.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Worauf man als nächstes achten sollte

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: Analysten werden an mehreren Stellen nach Bestätigung suchen:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - Dem nächsten ISM-Dienstleistungsbericht, um zu sehen, ob die gezahlten Preise hoch bleiben oder nachlassen.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - Den offiziellen VPI- und PCE-Inflationsdaten, insbesondere den Dienstleistungskategorien.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - Berichten über Lohnwachstum und den Arbeitsmarkt.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - Kommentaren von Fed-Vertretern darüber, wie sie die jüngsten Daten bewerten.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: Ein Index der gezahlten Preise von 74 garantiert zwar nicht, dass die Verbraucherpreise sprunghaft ansteigen werden, aber er deutet darauf hin, dass der Kostendruck in der Dienstleistungswirtschaft nach wie vor aktiv ist.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: Für die Haushalte könnte dies anhaltende Preiserhöhungen bei alltäglichen Dienstleistungen bedeuten.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: Für die Fed ist dies ein weiterer Beweis dafür, dass der Weg zurück zu einer stabilen Inflation möglicherweise nicht reibungslos verläuft.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: Die Beobachtung mehrerer Datenquellen im Laufe der Zeit anstelle der alleinigen Verlassung auf eine einzelne Schlagzeilennummer liefert das klarste Bild.

segments.src: ## What the ISM "Prices Paid" Index Measures

segments.src: - **The further above 50, the more widespread the reports of rising costs.**
segments.tr: - **Mức trên 50 càng cao, các báo cáo về chi phí tăng càng lan rộng.**

segments.src: A reading of 74 therefore signals that a large majority of surveyed firms are paying more for what they buy.
segments.tr: Do đó, mức đọc 74 báo hiệu rằng phần lớn các doanh nghiệp được khảo sát đang phải trả nhiều tiền hơn cho những gì họ mua.

segments.src: Because it is a diffusion index, it shows how *broad* the price increases are, not how large they are in percentage terms.
segments.tr: Vì đây là một chỉ số khuếch tán, nó cho thấy mức độ *lan rộng* của việc tăng giá, chứ không phải mức độ lớn của chúng tính theo phần trăm.

segments.src: A high reading means many firms are seeing higher costs, but it does not say by exactly how much.
segments.tr: Mức đọc cao có nghĩa là nhiều công ty đang chứng kiến chi phí cao hơn, nhưng nó không cho biết chính xác là bao nhiêu.

segments.src: ## Why the Services Sector Matters So Much
segments.tr: ## Lý do ngành dịch vụ lại quan trọng đến vậy

segments.src: economy and a large share of what households spend.
segments.tr: Mỹ và phần lớn chi tiêu của các hộ gia đình.

segments.tr: Điều đó bao gồm ăn uống ngoài, chăm sóc sức khỏe, bảo hiểm, giao thông vận tải, lưu trú, sửa chữa nhà cửa, chăm sóc cá nhân và các dịch vụ chuyên nghiệp.

segments.src: Services inflation tends to be stickier than goods inflation.
segments.tr: Lạm phát dịch vụ có xu hướng dai dẳng hơn lạm phát hàng hóa.

segments.src: A large part of the cost of a service is labor, and wages usually do not fall back quickly once they have risen.
segments.tr: Phần lớn chi phí của một dịch vụ là lao động, và tiền lương thường không giảm nhanh chóng một khi chúng đã tăng lên.

segments.src: As a result, when cost pressure builds in services, it can take a long time to work its way out of the system.
segments.tr: Kết quả là, khi áp lực chi phí tích tụ trong ngành dịch vụ, có thể mất nhiều thời gian để nó tự loại bỏ khỏi hệ thống.

segments.src: ## From Business Costs to Consumer Prices
segments.tr: ## Từ chi phí doanh nghiệp đến giá tiêu dùng

segments.src: Economists often describe a "pipeline" of price pressure.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế thường mô tả một "đường ống" áp lực giá.

segments.src: Costs rise at one stage, and businesses decide how much of that increase to absorb and how much to pass along.
segments.tr: Chi phí tăng ở một giai đoạn, và các doanh nghiệp quyết định bao nhiêu phần trăm của việc tăng đó để hấp thụ và bao nhiêu để chuyển sang người tiêu dùng.

segments.src: Several channels can link a high prices-paid reading to what people pay:
segments.tr: Một số kênh có thể liên kết mức giá đã trả cao với những gì mọi người phải trả:

segments.src: 1. **Restaurant meals.** Food ingredients, packaging, energy, and kitchen and wait staff wages all feed into menu prices. When several of these rise together, owners may raise prices or shrink portions.
segments.tr: 1. **Bữa ăn nhà hàng.** Thành phần thực phẩm, bao bì, năng lượng, và tiền lương nhân viên nhà bếp và phục vụ đều góp phần vào giá thực đơn. Khi một số yếu tố này tăng cùng nhau, chủ sở hữu có thể tăng giá hoặc thu nhỏ khẩu phần.

segments.src: 2. **Repairs and maintenance.** Parts, tools, fuel for service vehicles, and skilled labor all affect the bill for car repairs, appliance service, and home projects.
segments.tr: 2. **Sửa chữa và bảo dưỡng.** Phụ tùng, dụng cụ, nhiên liệu cho xe dịch vụ và lao động lành nghề đều ảnh hưởng đến hóa đơn sửa chữa ô tô, dịch vụ thiết bị gia dụng và các dự án nhà ở.

segments.src: 3. **Insurance and professional services.** Higher claim costs and operating expenses can show up as increased premiums or fees at renewal time.
segments.tr: 3. **Bảo hiểm và dịch vụ chuyên nghiệp.** Chi phí bồi thường cao hơn và chi phí hoạt động có thể xuất hiện dưới dạng phí bảo hiểm hoặc phí tăng lên vào thời điểm gia hạn.

segments.src: 4. **Travel and lodging.** Fuel, cleaning, staffing, and maintenance costs can influence fares and room rates.
segments.tr: 4. **Du lịch và lưu trú.** Chi phí nhiên liệu, dọn dẹp, nhân viên và bảo trì có thể ảnh hưởng đến giá vé và giá phòng.

segments.src: The pass-through is rarely immediate or complete.
segments.tr: Việc chuyển giao hiếm khi diễn ra ngay lập tức hoặc hoàn toàn.

segments.src: Competition, customer resistance, and each firm's profit margin all affect how much of a cost increase reaches the final price.
segments.tr: Cạnh tranh, sự kháng cự của khách hàng và biên lợi nhuận của mỗi công ty đều ảnh hưởng đến việc mức tăng chi phí đạt đến mức giá cuối cùng là bao nhiêu.

segments.src: Some businesses absorb higher costs for a while, while others adjust quickly.
segments.tr: Một số doanh nghiệp hấp thụ chi phí cao hơn trong một thời gian, trong khi những doanh nghiệp khác điều chỉnh nhanh chóng.

segments.src: That is why a survey reading is best seen as an early signal rather than a precise forecast.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao kết quả khảo sát được xem tốt nhất như một tín hiệu sớm chứ không phải là một dự báo chính xác.

segments.src: ## Why It Complicates the Fed's Job
segments.tr: ## Lý do nó làm phức tạp công việc của Fed

segments.src: The Federal Reserve aims for stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: Cục Dự trữ Liên bang hướng tới mức giá ổn định và việc làm tối đa.

segments.src: Policymakers watch many inflation indicators, and services prices receive special attention because they are persistent and closely tied to the labor market.
segments.tr: Các nhà hoạch định chính sách theo dõi nhiều chỉ số lạm phát, và giá dịch vụ nhận được sự chú ý đặc biệt vì chúng có tính dai dẳng và gắn kết chặt chẽ với thị trường lao động.

segments.src: A high prices-paid reading creates a few difficulties:
segments.tr: Mức giá đã trả cao tạo ra một vài khó khăn:

segments.src: - **It may slow progress on inflation.** If businesses face rising costs, they may keep raising prices, which makes it harder to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% goal.
segments.tr: - **Nó có thể làm chậm tiến độ kiềm chế lạm phát.** Nếu các doanh nghiệp phải đối mặt với chi phí tăng, họ có thể tiếp tục tăng giá, điều này làm cho việc đưa lạm phát trở lại mục tiêu 2% của Fed trở nên khó khăn hơn.

segments.src: - **It narrows the room for easing policy.** Lower interest rates can support growth and hiring, but they may also keep demand and prices elevated. A hot cost signal makes officials more cautious about cutting rates.
segments.tr: - **Nó thu hẹp dư địa nới lỏng chính sách.** Lãi suất thấp hơn có thể hỗ trợ tăng trưởng và việc làm, nhưng chúng cũng có thể giữ cho nhu cầu và giá cả ở mức cao. Tín hiệu chi phí nóng khiến các quan chức thận trọng hơn trong việc cắt giảm lãi suất.

segments.src: - **It sends mixed signals.** If growth or hiring is cooling at the same time that costs are rising, policymakers face a trade-off between supporting jobs and containing prices.
segments.tr: - **Nó gửi đi các tín hiệu trái chiều.** Nếu tăng trưởng hoặc việc làm đang hạ nhiệt đồng thời với việc chi phí tăng, các nhà hoạch định chính sách phải đối mặt với sự đánh đổi giữa việc hỗ trợ việc làm và kiềm chế giá cả.

segments.src: No single survey drives policy.
segments.tr: Không có cuộc khảo sát đơn lẻ nào điều khiển chính sách.

segments.src: The Fed looks at official inflation data such as the Consumer Price Index and the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, along with employment figures, wage growth, and inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Fed xem xét dữ liệu lạm phát chính thức như Chỉ số Giá tiêu dùng và chỉ số giá chi tiêu tiêu dùng cá nhân, cùng với các số liệu việc làm, tăng trưởng tiền lương và kỳ vọng lạm phát.

segments.src: Still, the ISM data are timely and are published before many government reports, so they can shape expectations about what those reports will show.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, dữ liệu ISM rất kịp thời và được công bố trước nhiều báo cáo của chính phủ, vì vậy chúng có thể định hình kỳ vọng về những gì các báo cáo đó sẽ thể hiện.

segments.src: ## Caveats Worth Keeping in Mind
segments.tr: ## Những lưu ý cần ghi nhớ

segments.src: - **Surveys are not hard data.** The ISM index reflects the opinions of purchasing managers, and monthly readings can be volatile.
segments.tr: - **Khảo sát không phải là dữ liệu cứng.** Chỉ số ISM phản ánh ý kiến của các nhà quản lý mua hàng, và các số liệu hàng tháng có thể biến động.

segments.src: - **One month is not a trend.** Economists generally want to see whether the reading stays elevated over several months.
segments.tr: - **Một tháng không phải là một xu hướng.** Các nhà kinh tế nói chung muốn xem liệu mức đọc có duy trì ở mức cao trong vài tháng hay không.

segments.src: - **Cost pressure is not the same as consumer inflation.** Some firms may absorb increases, and official price indexes can move differently from survey results.
segments.tr: - **Áp lực chi phí không giống như lạm phát tiêu dùng.** Một số công ty có thể hấp thụ mức tăng, và các chỉ số giá chính thức có thể di chuyển khác với kết quả khảo sát.

segments.src: - **Other factors can distort readings.** Energy prices, trade policy, weather events, or supply disruptions can temporarily lift costs without changing the longer-term picture.
segments.tr: - **Các yếu tố khác có thể bóp méo số liệu.** Giá năng lượng, chính sách thương mại, các hiện tượng thời tiết hoặc sự gián đoạn nguồn cung có thể tạm thời làm tăng chi phí mà không làm thay đổi bức tranh dài hạn hơn.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.src: Analysts will look for confirmation in several places:
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích sẽ tìm kiếm sự xác nhận ở một số nơi:

segments.src: - The next ISM services report, to see whether prices paid stays high or eases.
segments.tr: - Báo cáo dịch vụ ISM tiếp theo, để xem liệu giá đã trả có duy trì ở mức cao hay giảm bớt.

segments.src: - Official CPI and PCE inflation data, particularly the services categories.
segments.tr: - Dữ liệu lạm phát CPI và PCE chính thức, đặc biệt là các danh mục dịch vụ.

segments.src: - Wage growth and labor market reports.
segments.tr: - Tăng trưởng tiền lương và các báo cáo thị trường lao động.

segments.src: - Commentary from Fed officials about how they are weighing recent data.
segments.tr: - Bình luận từ các quan chức Fed về cách họ đang cân nhắc dữ liệu gần đây.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: A prices-paid reading of 74 does not guarantee that consumer prices will jump, but it suggests that cost pressure in the services economy is still active.
segments.tr: Mức giá đã trả là 74 không đảm bảo rằng giá tiêu dùng sẽ tăng vọt, nhưng nó cho thấy áp lực chi phí trong nền kinh tế dịch vụ vẫn đang hoạt động.

segments.src: For households, that could mean continued price increases for everyday services.
segments.tr: Đối với các hộ gia đình, điều đó có thể có nghĩa là giá cả tiếp tục tăng đối với các dịch vụ hàng ngày.

segments.src: For the Fed, it is one more piece of evidence that the path back to stable inflation may not be smooth.
segments.tr: Đối với Fed, đó là một bằng chứng nữa cho thấy con đường quay trở lại mức lạm phát ổn định có thể không suôn sẻ.

segments.src: Following several data sources over time, rather than relying on one headline number, gives the clearest picture.
segments.tr: Theo dõi nhiều nguồn dữ liệu theo thời gian, thay vì dựa vào một con số tiêu đề duy nhất, sẽ mang lại bức tranh rõ ràng nhất.
